purpose: Fixed descriptive loss/profit mechanism review; no strategy edits, extra MT5 runs, parameter search, simulated exits, or promotion.
population: All 475 completed positions, separately A=M15/M5 and B=M5/M1; wins/losses use execution net cash, not SL/TP names.
time_basis: Broker/source timestamps; no unverified UTC conversion.
entry_features: Use each setup's ORDER event strictly preceding its FILL in native event sequence. Realized fills/outcomes do not redefine feature buckets. Latest upper bars are limited to known_at <= ORDER event_at.

sl_upper_tr14.formula: abs(ORDER.entry_price - ORDER.sl_price) / arithmetic_mean(last 14 closed upper true ranges)

exit_mechanism.role: Post-entry outcome decomposition only; never a prospective entry feature

holding_time: Post-entry explanation only: median minutes by exit mechanism and net WIN/LOSS.
half_split: Entry date < 2020-07-01 is H1; otherwise H2. No held-out claim: entire year has already been inspected.
small_sample: n < 30 is explicitly flagged; half-year sign changes also flagged. Flags are descriptive, not significance tests.
examples: First chronologically completed eligible position for each arm and fixed sl_upper_tr14 LT_1/GE_2 x net WIN/LOSS, plus the first opposite-W1 profit exit; no best/worst selection.
limitations: Observed trades are selected by the existing EA; this does not evaluate rejected candidates.
One year, generated ticks and historical cost uncertainty; no out-of-sample inference.
Fixed buckets are interpretable units, not thresholds recommended for adoption.
No counterfactual conclusion from actual TP/SL or opposite-W1 exits.
